name: uk.co.dustyspizza.mcp/dustys-pizza
title: Dusty's Pizza
description: Dusty's Pizza, Cardiff: menu, opening times, table requests and orders for collection.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Returns Dusty's menu as it is right now: pizzas, sides, dips and desserts with prices in pounds, what is in each, a link to the restaurant's own photograph of the dish where there is one, vegan, vegetarian and spicy marks, the pizza of the day and of the week, and anything sold out. Availability changes during service.

tools.name: get_opening_info
tools.description: Returns where Dusty's is, how to reach it, whether it is open for collection at this moment, how long an order takes right now and the earliest collection time, the collection times on offer, the days and times for tables, the ways to eat (collect an order, walk in, or book a table) and the booking rules.

tools.name: get_table_availability
tools.description: Returns the table times on one day and whether a party of this size can be seated at each. Tables can be requested up to two weeks ahead. An empty list means the restaurant is closed that day or the day is out of range.

date.description: The day, as YYYY-MM-DD, on the restaurant clock (Europe/London).

party_size.description: How many people, from 1 to 12. For more than 12, the person should call the restaurant.

tools.name: request_table_booking
tools.description: Sends Dusty's a request for a table on a given day and time, with the person's name, phone number and email address. The restaurant answers the person by email; the table is not confirmed until it does. The time must be one of the restaurant's table times for that day.

date.description: The day, as YYYY-MM-DD, on the restaurant clock (Europe/London).

time.description: The time, as HH:MM on the 24-hour restaurant clock, e.g. 18:30. One of the restaurant's table times for that day.

party_size.description: How many people, from 1 to 12. For more than 12, the person should call the restaurant.

name.description: The person's name, for the booking.

phone.description: The person's phone number, so the restaurant can reach them.

email.description: The person's email address: the confirmation is sent there.

notes.description: Anything the restaurant should know, e.g. a special request. Optional.

tools.name: start_order
tools.description: Checks a list of menu items, and a collection time if one is given, against the menu and the kitchen as they are right now, and returns a link to a ready-filled basket on Dusty's website with the total. Nothing is ordered or charged by this tool: the person opens the link, checks it and pays on the website. Pizzas come as 'Classic' or with a 'Hot honey' crust. Changes to a pizza (for example no basil) are made by the person on the website.

name.description: The item's name on Dusty's menu, e.g. Margherita.

option.description: For a pizza: 'Classic' or 'Hot honey'. Leave out for the plain one.

collection_time.description: When the person wants to collect, as HH:MM on the 24-hour restaurant clock (18:30 for half past six in the evening). Left out, the order is for as soon as possible. Orders are taken for the next open evening only, at times on the quarter hour.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sends Dusty's a message from a person, with their name, phone number and email address: a question, a special request, or something about a booking or an order. It goes to the restaurant's inbox and the restaurant replies to the person by email. It is not answered at once, and it does not book a table.

email.description: The person's email address: the restaurant replies there.

phone.description: The person's phone number, so the restaurant can ring if that is quicker.
